note: Static documents for the Knowledge Finder index. Add documents here (or to the MongoDB knowledge_docs collection) — the engine reloads on file change without a deploy. Every document carries access metadata; internal_only documents are excluded from search entirely.

documents.title: Membership Tiers & Plans
documents.description: Free, Member, Plus, Pro, Patron, and Executive (customer) tiers. Each paid tier includes everything below it plus its own features. AI is not included in any tier — AI runs on your own key via the $3 BYOK unlock.
documents.body: The plans page lists every membership tier with its price and included features. Higher tiers inherit lower-tier access. Customer tiers never include platform-funded AI: live AI runs on your own key through the one-time $3 BYOK unlock.

documents.title: BYOK — Bring Your Own Key
documents.description: The one-time $3 BYOK unlock lets you use AI with your own free API key from Groq, Cerebras, or Gemini. Your AI requests run on YOUR key — the platform does not fund customer AI at any tier.
documents.body: BYOK means Bring Your Own Key. Complete the one-time $3 unlock on the BYOK page, then paste a free API key from Groq (console.groq.com), Cerebras (cloud.cerebras.ai), or Google Gemini (aistudio.google.com). Your AI then runs on your own key — free to you, zero cost to the platform. Staff roles receive BYOK free.

documents.title: How AI Works on This Platform
documents.description: Anonymous visitors get no AI. Customers at any tier get no platform-funded AI — their AI runs on their own BYOK key, or they use the free knowledge base. Platform-funded AI is reserved for authorized staff.
documents.body: AI runs on real computing resources that cost money. To keep the platform free and sustainable: anonymous visitors get no AI; customers at any tier get no platform-funded AI; AI runs on your own key via the $3 BYOK unlock; everyone else gets the free knowledge base. If you want more AI capacity, upgrade your own key or provider plan.

documents.title: Courses & Learning Modules
documents.description: Free courses, modules, labs, and credentials in the Learn section. Browse, enroll, and complete at your own pace; progress saves automatically to your account.
documents.body: The Learn section has free courses, modules, labs, and simulations. Open a course and work through modules at your own pace; your progress is saved automatically. Lab completions count toward certificates and credentials.

documents.title: Certificates & Credentials
documents.description: Completing required courses and labs unlocks certificates and verified credentials, viewable and downloadable from your dashboard.
documents.body: Certificates and verified credentials appear in your dashboard after your work is graded and marked complete. From there you can view, download, and share them. If a completed course isn't showing, confirm 100% progress and contact the Help Center.

documents.title: Community
documents.description: The community section is where members post, discuss, and share. Create posts, comment, and engage under the community code of conduct.
documents.body: The Community section is where members post, discuss, and share. Report any content that breaks the code of conduct; the moderation team reviews every report.

documents.title: Store & Marketplace
documents.description: Digital products — workbooks, courses, and more. Physical merchandise is listed but not sold online yet. Purchases are delivered to your account automatically.
documents.body: The Store carries digital products — workbooks, courses, and more. Physical merchandise like t-shirts is listed but not available for online purchase yet. Purchases are processed through our payment provider and delivered to your account automatically.

documents.title: Payments, Subscriptions & Billing
documents.description: Checkout runs through Lemon Squeezy or Gumroad. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Payment history and receipts live in your account.
documents.body: Payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy (primary) or Gumroad (fallback) — we never handle card numbers directly. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; cancel anytime from your account or the provider's portal. Your payment history and receipts are in your account.

documents.title: Refund Policy
documents.description: Refunds are issued as site credit unless the failure was the platform's fault, in which case we refund the original payment method.
documents.body: Refunds are issued as site credit unless the failure was the platform's fault, in which case we refund the original payment method. See the Refund Policy page for the full policy and how to request a refund.

documents.title: Privacy Policy
documents.description: What we collect (name, email, progress), how it's used, and your rights including access, deletion, and export. We do not sell personal data.
documents.body: Our Privacy Policy explains what we collect (name, email, learning progress), how it is used, and your rights: access, export, deletion, and portability. We do not sell personal data. When you use BYOK, conversation content goes to the AI provider you chose.

documents.title: Terms of Service
documents.description: Account rules, acceptable use, AI-generated content, payments, and user content. You must be at least 13 to create an account.
documents.body: The Terms of Service cover account rules, acceptable use, AI-generated content, payments, and user content. You must be at least 13 years old. Breaking the rules can lead to suspension.

documents.title: Help Center & Human Support
documents.description: Real people answer at the M.O.R.E. Help Center — tickets, troubleshooting, and billing support. Contact them for anything account or platform related.
documents.body: Real people answer at the M.O.R.E. Help Center — tickets, troubleshooting, and billing support. For life-help needs, 211 is free, confidential, and available 24/7.

documents.title: Site Guide
documents.description: A guided tour of the platform: where everything lives and how to get the most out of it.
documents.body: The Site Guide is a guided tour of the platform — where everything lives, how learning works, and how to get the most out of your account.

documents.title: Scholarships & Sponsorship
documents.description: Scholarship applications are reviewed by the committee. Sponsors fund milestone-based releases so funds follow real progress.
documents.body: Scholarship applications are submitted through the Scholarships section and reviewed by the scholarship committee. Sponsors can fund a scholar full, partial, or collectively; funds release on verified milestones you can track.

documents.title: 211 — Free Local Help
documents.description: 211 connects you to free local services: housing, food, legal aid, health, benefits, utilities, and more. Free, confidential, 24/7.
documents.body: 211 is a free, confidential, 24/7 phone line that connects you to local services — housing, food, legal aid, health, benefits, utilities, and more. Dial 2-1-1 from any phone or visit 211.org to search by ZIP code. Interpreters are available in many languages.

documents.title: 988 — Crisis Support
documents.description: 988 is the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline — call or text 988 for free, confidential support 24/7. In immediate danger, call 911.
documents.body: 988 is the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline — call or text 988 for free, confidential support 24/7. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 911.

documents.title: Music — Band Pages & Playlists
documents.description: Band on a Page lets you create a music page for your band; Playlist Manager curates and organizes tracks. Available at the appropriate membership tier.
documents.body: Band on a Page lets you create a music page for your band, and Playlist Manager curates tracks into playlists. Creation tools unlock at the appropriate membership tier; make sure you have rights to everything you upload.

documents.title: Games & Leaderboard
documents.description: Interactive games tied to learning and community. Scores feed the community leaderboard — only verified play counts.
documents.body: The Games section has interactive games tied to learning and community. Your scores feed the community leaderboard — only verified play counts, no shortcuts.

documents.title: Account, Login & Settings
documents.description: Register, sign in, reset your password, update your profile, export or delete your data. Account self-service lives in your Settings.
documents.body: Create a free account to unlock the site. Reset a forgotten password from the login page, update your profile in Settings, and export or delete your data from Account Settings. You must be at least 13 years old.

documents.title: The Sanctuary
documents.description: A focused space for deeper work and reflection, available at the appropriate membership tier.
documents.body: The Sanctuary is a focused space for deeper work and reflection, available at the appropriate membership tier. See your sidebar for what your tier includes.
